tools.name: search_products
tools.description:
Search products for a buyer intent. Returns ranked candidates with price, availability and product_id.
    Call get_product(product_id) before quoting a specific variant. Prices in major units (USD).

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Live details for one product: variants, price, stock status, checkout links.

tools.name: create_checkout
tools.description:
Start a purchase. v0 returns the merchant's checkout link for the chosen variant plus a Kaupia
    checkout_id. Keep the checkout_id and call report_outcome later so the order is covered and ranked.

tools.name: report_outcome
tools.description: Report what happened to a checkout: placed | delivered | wrong_item | late | refunded | failed.

tools.name: shop_scorecard
tools.description: Per-shop outcome stats collected through Kaupia (delivered vs problems).
